question: What numerical measure defines the best grade of the nine-tāla system?
premises: The best grade is associated with nine tālas.
A numerical measure of parts is specified.
This measure is prescribed as the standard.
inference: The best nine-tāla measure should consist of the specified number of parts.
uncertainties: sadvādaśaśataṃ is metrically compressed and its exact numerical value is uncertain
plain_english: The best nine-tāla measure should consist of the specified twelve hundred and six parts.
